scope: Stage 4D targeted static gameplay review over the unchanged Stage 4B source-clause census; original source fields and canonical identities retained.
reviewMethod: Persistent source owners are Stage 2A identities. Clause addresses are immutable accepted source field ranges guarded by field and quote fingerprints, not new canonical entity identities. Sentence boundaries are transcription locators only, never effect inference. Source layout headings and three nested overlaps are separately accounted. Executable statuses require actual typed binding and runtime evidence before promotion.

coverage.notCountedAsAdditionalEffects: Model/weapon numeric facts and native weapon tokens are retained in nativeWeaponInventory; they are not new independent source rule clauses. Wargear choice/caps/replacement legality is outside V2 gameplay scope. UNIT/DETACHMENT structural records do not become artificial effect clauses. Deathwatch records remain outside Space Marines ownership.
coverage.denominatorMeaning: Literal operative source clauses, including applicability/recipient/timing/limit clauses and native references. This is not a count of independent numeric operations. Embedded Enhancement weapon table is one complete grant; layout introductions, examples and duplicate nested text are not counted.
coverage.runtimeProofScope: Stage4B original40 typed cases preserved; Stage4D static typed/physical bindings tested through native runtime, Effective and Guide projectors; Stage4C constructed New Recruit import regression. Real New Recruit exports and frontend/browser acceptance are not claimed.

records.contextQuote:
Teleport Homer (Once per battle, per unit): At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit on the battlefield. If you do:
- When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, you can use that Teleport Homer token. If you do, that use is -1 CP, but when resolving that stratagem, this unit must be set up within 3" of that Teleport Homer token and not within 8" of an enemy unit. - If an enemy unit ends a move within 1" of that Teleport Homer token, that Teleport Homer token is removed from the battlefield.

records.contextQuote:
Teleport Homer (Once per battle, per unit): At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit on the battlefield. If you do:

records.sourceQuote: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter.
records.contextQuote:
Space Marine Chapters
If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter. For example, Marneus Calgar has both the ADEPTUS ASTARTES and ULTRAMARINES Faction keywords,and is therefore from the Ultramarines Chapter.
You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

records.contextQuote:
Librarius
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.
In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.
Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

records.title: Combat Doctrines
records.quote: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below.
records.sourceQuote: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below.
records.contextQuote:
Combat Doctrines
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.
ASSAULT DOCTRINE
When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
TACTICAL DOCTRINE
When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.
Unless otherwise stated:
- You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
- Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

PSYCHIC ABILITIES

- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- This unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.

records.quote: Veil of Time (psychic level 1): When this unit is selected to make an advance move, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6.
records.sourceQuote: Veil of Time (psychic level 1): When this unit is selected to make an advance move, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6.
records.contextQuote:
PSYCHIC ABILITIES
Veil of Time (psychic level 1): When this unit is selected to make an advance move, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- This unit can change that advance roll to a 6.
Force Dome (psychic level 1): In your Movement phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.
- This unit has 4+ InSv until the start of your next turn.

Shrouding (psychic level 1): When an enemy unit targets this unit, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do:
- On a 1, this unit is battle-shocked.

records.quote: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
records.sourceQuote: WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
records.contextQuote:
EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
1CP
Ceramite Sentinels Stratagem
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
EFFECT:
- Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
- Or: If your unit is entrenched, your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Your unit is not able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.
